metadata.page_title: Love(land) Hurts vs Millan’s Last Supper matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Love(land) Hurts won by 2.2. Love(land) Hurts left 20.6 lineup points on the table, while Millan’s Last Supper left 6.7.
summary.historical_summary: Love(land) Hurts is 7-5 against Millan’s Last Supper across 12 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Love(land) Hurts
summary.winner_reason: Love(land) Hurts won by 2.2, led by a 40.2-point edge at RB. The leading starters were Quinshon Judkins (29.4) and Tee Higgins (26.8). Recent pickup Kyler Murray added 16.9 lineup points.
summary.loser_reason: Millan’s Last Supper could not match the opponent's RB production, losing that position battle by 40.2 points. Jets scored 1.0. Its best legal lineup added 6.7, enough to put the lineup decisions directly in the result.
